chapters: Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Josuee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' chɨkka jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux no'ch maa'n gu ux bhaan gu Kananeos.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; gio ba' gu Judaa jix tɨ'ɨ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' dhagia' gu oidha' gu noobh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Judaa gu Simeoon xibhɨk; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Kananeo tu' gio tu jiim bɨndak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu Simeoon ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Judaa gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh gu Kananeo gu jodai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Besek mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Adoni-besek gu tasi' gu ux bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Kananeo gu jodai'.
Gu' gu' gu Adoni-besek jix duñia'; gio ba' bhiadat jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu noobh tɨɨt.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Adoni-besek; gio ba' gu Setenta gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu noobh tɨɨt jix duñia' iigɨsda' bɨtaa'n gu vaak na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jerusalem pai' jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jugi gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu tai kiicham.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Judaa jix dhaav na ba' gu ux bhaan gu Kananeo jix daa gɨ' kavɨk saagi'ñ gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu Judaa bhaan gu Kananeo jix daa gu ebroon jup tɨɨt va'k gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Sesai gu Aiman gu Talmai.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñka' gu Debir va'k jup tɨɨt gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Kaleb; na gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ tu' gu suudai' gu jodai' mar u'vɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Otoniel gu mar gu Kenes xibhɨk jix ali' gu Kaleb; gio ba' jix maa gu jodai' mar u'vɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu suudai' gu taat yooxi'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Kaleb jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; na jix maa gu oidha' gu takarui' gu chuukug gio gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; jano' ba' gu Kaleb jix maa gu ñi'ook jiix gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Kineo jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees jix tɨ'ɨ kiicham gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Judaa oidha' jix gaki gu Judaa saagi'ñ gu Arad; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu jix daa bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Judaa xibhɨk gu Simeoon jix duñia' gu Kananeo jix daa gu Sepat jix duñia'; gio ba' jix dhaas gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham gu orma.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu Judaa gu Gasa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Askaloon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Ekroon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Judaa mi'x juu'ñ gɨ' kavɨk; gu' cham gu ñi'ook mi'x juu'ñ oi'ñka' gu bhóogɨt ko'kmarak gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu ebroon gu Kaleb na ja'p gu Moisees ka't tu ñi'ook; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ vaik gu ma'nkam gu Anak.
Gu' gu' gu Jebuseo jix daa gu Jerusalem cham mi'x juu'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Jebuseo jix daa bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Jerusalem bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gio gu vaak gu Josee jix tɨ'ɨ gu Bet-el; gio ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Josee jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu Bet-el kiicham va'k jup tɨɨt gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ busaak kiicham gui'p; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' ba'k kiicham chulhiiñchuda' bɨndak xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' ba'k kiicham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii; gu' mi'x dhaas mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu jum duu gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham jup tɨɨt gu tasi'; gio ba' dhi' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Tampoko gu Manasees mi'x juu'ñ gu Bet-sean tu' taañpu' tu' gu Taanak taañpu' tu' gu Dor taañpu' tu' gu suudai' gu Ibleam taañpu' tu' oi'ñka' gu Megiddo taañpu'; gu' gu Kananeo gu oi'ñga'n jix daa dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ tu' na jix kavɨk gu Kananeo bopxi'ñ gu' cham mi'x juu'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Epraim mi'x juu'ñ gu Kananeo jix daa gu Geser; gio ba' va'k jix daa gu Kananeo tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Geser.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook mi'x juu'ñ oi'ñka' gu bhóogɨt oi'ñka' gu Naalol; gu' gu Kananeo jix daa tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Aser mi'x juu'ñ oi'ñka' gu Akô oi'ñka' gu Sidoon gu Alab gu Aksib gu elba gu Apek gu Reod.
Jano' ba' va'k jix koi gu Aser tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kananeos oi'ñka' gu oidha'; na gu' cham mi'x juu'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu chuukug mi'x juu'ñ oi'ñka' gu Bet-semes oi'ñka' gu Bet-anat gu ñi'ook jix koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kananeos oi'ñka' gu oidha'; gu' jix bɨɨx duu bopxi'ñ jix koi gu Bet-semes jix koi gu Bet-anat.
Jano' ba' gu Amorreos jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk; na cham mi'x dhaas jix dhaav vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Amorreo jix daa gu kavɨk gu eres gu ñi'ook gu Saalbiin; gu' na ja'p gu novɨ gu vaak gu Josee jix bhɨɨ tu' na jix kavɨk jix duu bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Amorreo ka't dɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu Akrabim dɨr gu jodai jiix.

Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ gu Gilgal gu Bokîm; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ejipto gu chuukug gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook tattat; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mɨɨjidha' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu takarui' cham xoi'kam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx jix koi gu chuukug gu oidha' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia'; gu' gu takarui' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' gio tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook ka't gu ux gu chuukug na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Bokîm; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Josuee ka't jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu suudai' gu ja'tkam maa'n gu maa'nkar na ba' bia'ka'.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Josuee bɨx gu ñi'ook daraa jix duñia' gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr gu Josuee gu suudai' buupui bɨx buimɨi gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' chamaam mambhɨɨx gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Timnat-sera gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Gaas.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx tattat; gio ba' jix búup mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Baales.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat ka't jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam mi'p xikoolh o'lhia; gio ba' jix duñia' daak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios o'lhia gu Baal gu Astarot.
Jano' ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tai bhaan gu Israeel do'ñcho gu noobh gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu noobh obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ux pai' gu bhóogɨt jix buus gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan na ba' cham bhai' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu novɨ jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ o'lhia; gio ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam jootom gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' tattat gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham jix duu.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx jir bɨx bhai' jix duñia' gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr jir bɨx bhai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n kuiñcha tu jiim gu suudai'.

Gu' gu' vaak jodai jir bɨx bhai' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n tattat gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' tu juan gu jodai' vupui bhaan; gio ba' cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n buimɨi tu' jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' daak gu Jawatan Dios gu tai bhaan gu Israeel; na gu' dhi' gu ja'tkam bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu chuukug tattat cham dhu'npi'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' tu' mi'x juu'ñ gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan matgɨm gu suudai' chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook gu Josuee na pai' dhuuk jix koi.
Na ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' gu Israeel tu' nukadham gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios jiim gu ñi'ook na ja'p tattat gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' mi'x dhaas gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp cham jix duñia' tu' do'ñcho gu novɨ gu Josuee.
Jano' ba' dhi' chɨbɨɨp mi'x dhaas gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Israeel bɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam cham gu suudai' gu tasi' bɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kanaan.
Na ba' na ba' gu vupui gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham gu suudai' jum duu va'k cham gu suudai' gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam chiñia' gu Pilisteos bɨx gu Kananeos gu Sidonios gu ñi'ook oi'ñka' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dɨr gu kavɨk gu Baal-ermoon bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Israeel na ba' maachim tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu suudai' tattat gu ux gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oi'ñka' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Kananeos gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Amorreos gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseos.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ jix maa ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Baales duiñxim gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu tai bhaan gu Israeel jix duñia' gu noobh gu Kusan-risataim gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Kusan-risataim gu tasi' gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' boosolh gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr maachim gu Otoniel gu mar gu Kenes xibhɨk jix ali' gu Kaleb.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Israeel jix buus gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu novɨ gu Kusan-risataim gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu Kusan-risataim.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ gu oidha' oo'm gu takarui'; gio ba' jix koi gu Otoniel gu mar gu Kenes.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel duñia' cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Egloon gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab bhaan gu Israeel na gu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ baidhak gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Amalek ka't naaka'n gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ kiicham gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Egloon gu gɨ'kora' gu Moabitas mambhɨɨx gu tasi' gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' boosolh gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Gera gu Benjamita ga'ra' jix kup gu novɨ tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mɨjɨ bɨɨx gu o'o gu Egloon gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook mu'muk novɨ maa'nkar jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨtaa'n jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu o'o gu Egloon gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab; gio ba' ka't gu Egloon gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu takarui' gu duukam jix duñia' gu ja'tkam ka't gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' jix duñia' dɨr duiñxim gu Gilgal; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt no'ñ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' moor bɨɨx bɨx vupui bhaan mi'p.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't daakat gu duukam gu chuukug gu vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr no'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu'; jano' ba' jix búup gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu novɨ o'nsop jix bhɨɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ux vook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook chɨbiapui gio bhaan jajar gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajar cham jix buusñi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vook; gio ba' jix buus gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gamai' gu ñi'ook naadat gu ñi'ook bhaan kiki'ñgob gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨɨtɨs tu duukam ñɨi'ñ kiki'ñgob gu chuukug jix kup gui'p; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tɨɨt gu chuukug gu vaak.
Jano' ba' dhaibu gu duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiki'ñgob gu chuukug jix bhɨɨ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan gu vaak gu oidha' jix koi.
Gu' gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhɨi duiñxim jix duñia' gu Seirat.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't kia'mi'ñ jix duñia' gu suudai' gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix dhaav bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu chuukug vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; na gu' gu suudai' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' obhɨɨ'ñ gu Moabitas gu noobh; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Jordaan gu Moab cham mi'x dhaas gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Moabitas na ja'p mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ bɨx jix kavɨk bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ.
Na ba' jix duñia' gu Moab gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Israeel; gio ba' jix utu'ñ gu oidha' jix bhai'x gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ux ka't gu Samgar gu mar gu Anat naaka'n gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ gu Pilisteos bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu vaakax; gio ba' gio gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr koi'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Kanaan jix gɨ'kora' gu Asor; gio ba' gu suudai' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jup tɨɨt gu Siisara jix daa gu aroset chɨbɨɨp.
Na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu bhóogɨt ga'ra' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu u'vɨ gu Deebora gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu u'vɨ gu Lapidot.
Jano' ba' gu Deebora jix daa bɨtaa'n gu novɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Rama gu Bet-el gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' bhañ tɨɨt gu Barak gu mar gu Abinoam gu Kedes gu chuukug; gio ba' cham tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bham; mi' dhɨr tu' gu vupui gu ja'tkam gu kavɨk gu Tabor jix bhɨɨ bɨndak mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' gu Kisoon gu Siisara gu suudai' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jabiin bɨɨx gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham kapbhai' gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu Barak jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tu' tu jiim; gu' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu chuukug cham tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu jiim bɨndak; gu' cham ka't nɨidhat gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu novɨ gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Siisara; gio ba' kɨkbo gu Deebora ka't bɨɨx gu Barak gu Kedes.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu tasi' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu suudai' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' gu Deebora jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu eber gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu obab jir bɨx bhai' gu Moisees ka't gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook vaak zel bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu Saananim ju'ñdharan gu Kedes.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Siisara na ja'p gu Barak gu mar gu Abinoam ka't jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu Tabor.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu takarui' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't dɨr gu aroset chɨbɨɨp bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' gu Kisoon.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Deebora gu Barak; gio ba' bamii'; na gu' dhi' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu Siisara gu noobh; jano' ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan tu' gu Barak jix dhaav gu kavɨk gu Tabor mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Siisara bɨx gu bhóogɨt bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii vupui bhaan gu tasi'; gio ba' gu Siisara jix dhaav gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' tɨɨt.
Gu' gu' gu Barak chɨ'ɨɨk gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka'm gu aroset chɨbɨɨp bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Siisara jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii bɨɨx ka'm cham gu ñi'ook tu' maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu Siisara jix duñia' tɨɨt vaak zel gu Jael gu u'vɨ gu eber gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Asor gu vaak gu eber gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gamai' gu Jael gu takarui' gu Siisara; gio ba' gu kutun gu Jawatan gu chuukug gu kutun tu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ choo'n; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va vaak zel jix bhaan dhaas bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug i'i gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai' no'ñ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix kupi'ook gu tasi' bii'm jix maa i'i jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' ki'ñgob vaak zel tu' jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n tu' tu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch oi'ñdha' tu' tu ñi'ook cham.

Jano' ba' gu Jael gu u'vɨ gu eber jix bhɨɨ dhi' vaak zel jix dhaas gu duukam gu novɨ suudai' u'va jix bhai'x jix duñia' dhi' gu ux gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook koox jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Barak gu Siisara gu Jael jix buus tu jiim; gio ba' jix ai tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr chɨbiapui pai' ka't gu suudai' gu Siisara gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix koi bɨɨx dhi' gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Kanaan vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel kua'da' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu Kanaan bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jiiñ gu Deebora bɨɨx gu Barak gu mar gu Abinoam bham.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel na gu' gu ja'tkam tu' gu suudai' aagak jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chiñia' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' gu Seir gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk tu' gu takarui' yooxi' gu Edom gu oidha' jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' tɨbaa'ñ jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Sinaii vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Samgar gu mar gu Anat gu tanoolh gu Jael gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jiim gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ux gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' taañpu' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Israeel gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu Deebora gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu naan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xixiibkam gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't kiki'ñgob; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ oo'm jix bhai'x gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu ux chiñia' gu Israeel bɨɨx jix bhai' aagak jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook chooto gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu takarui' gu ux tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' tɨroon u'u gat gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bhai' gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel; gio ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu Despierta gu oi'ñga'n gu Deebora; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu duukam; mi' dhɨr bamii' gu Barak gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Abinoam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ'kora' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu takarui' bhaan jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim jix buus tatk bhaan gu Amalek bhaan tu' gu Benjamiin bhaan gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Makîr jix dhaav chiñia' gu ñi'ook gu tas gu suudai' gu tasi' gu o'o.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gio gu Issakâr jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx gu Deebora; gio ba' na ja'p gu Issakâr gio gu Barak jix dhaas tɨɨt gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu Rubeen ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu Rubeen jix bɨɨx duu gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu Dan gu ux gu ñi'ook juruuñ ju'ñdharan gu takarui' gu jodai' gu Aser gu vaak gu gɨ' suudai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu oidha' koi'm gu chuukug gu ñi'ook yooxi'.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu gɨ'kora' gu ux; gio ba' jano' ba' gu ux gu gɨ'kora' gu Kanaan gu Taanak ju'ñdharan gu suudai' gu Megiddo gu' cham bhɨɨk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tuumiñ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨkɨr gu ux; gio ba' gu si'avag dɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ux bhaan gu Siisara.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhi'ñbak gu Kisoon jix bhai'x bhi'ñbak gu Kisoon; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n kavaayo gu ux gu takarui' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Meros nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x jix koi na gu' cham tɨɨtɨs gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ gu Jael gu u'vɨ gu eber gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' bhaan gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt ka't vaak zel.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' jix maa bii'm; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ jix duñia' dhi' kɨɨ'n gu duukam gu jodai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Siisara naaka'n mo'o jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨɨt jix duñia' gu chuukug; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨɨt jix duñia'; na pai' jix duñia' jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu naan gu Siisara gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ jiiñak tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt cham jupaabkamu'n gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gaagam gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'n gu bhóogɨt gook; gio ba' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu Siisara gu takarui' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n na ba' baakux jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu' gu takarui' ka't na ja'p gu tas na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' jix utu'ñ oo'm gu takarui'.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh gu Madiaan gu ux kɨɨv gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu Madiaan jix duñia' bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux kuiñcha gu bhóogɨt jix duu gu suudai' gu kakkavɨk gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk.
Na gu' na ja'p gu Israeel gu suudai' jix tɨ'ɨ gu bhóogɨt gu Amalekitas gu jodai'; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' yooxi' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug gu Gasa; gio ba' cham mi'x dhaas gu oi'ñga'n jugi gu Israeel tu' kakneer tu' gu vaakax tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu suudai' aajidha' bɨɨx vaak zel jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu ñi'ook cham ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' tu' jix ai; gio ba' aajidha' gu oidha' na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel a'lhiok duuñ gu Jawatan Dios kuiñcha gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix buus gu Ejipto gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak juantu'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu novɨ gu Egipkios gu novɨ bɨx jix duñia' mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu Yo jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu Amorreos gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt; gu' cham jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix daa bɨtaa'n gu oi'ñga'n gu Opra ka't gu Joas gu Abieserita; gio ba' gu mar gu chuukug ka't tu jiim tiriik gu Jawatan na ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak gu chio'ñ gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu chuukug tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx no'ch gu tasi' gu ñi'ook tu' daam bɨx dhi' duukat bɨx kɨɨ'p taata'n tattat jix duñia' bham; mi' dhɨr cham jix buusñi gu Jawatan Dios gu Ejipto jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix bhai'x tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx dhi' gu kavɨk u'ua'tɨda' gu Israeel gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr cham tu' jootsa' tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ñi'ook no'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu suudai' ja'tkam vaak gampai' gu Manasees tu' jix ali' gu vaak gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨndak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu duukam gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Yo tu' soi'ñ tu' gaagam nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan tu' gu chuukug nɨi'ñchudat tu' tu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' cham tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu o'o jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Yo gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' cham jabka' gu Epa gu tasi'; gio ba' jix dhaas gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu chuukug jix duñia' bɨtaa'n mii' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug gu takarui' cham jabka' gu takarui' bhaan dhi' gu jodai' na jix uam gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr jix duu.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' ga'ra' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu takarui' cham jabka'; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tai jodai kavɨk jix duñia' gu chuukug gu takarui' cham jabka'; mi' dhɨr nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu chuukug ka't nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios buupui nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ choo'n cham koi.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jup tɨɨt gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Opra gu Abieseritas.

Ba' jix aa' ka't gu tukaa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' na jix uam gu duukam gu taat gu jodai' na jix uam kɨɨv gu takarui' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal gu taat juraa'n gu ñi'ook gio gu ux ju'ñdharan.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ux dhi' gu jodai' na jix uam pai' jix duñia'; gio ba' dhaagɨk gook gu jodai' na jix uam gu chuukug maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan gu u'u gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu chuukug jix bhɨɨ mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ tu duukam jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu ñi'ook duñia' gu tanoolh gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu taat gu ux gu chichio'ñ kiicham jix duu gu tukaa'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu xibh na pai' dhuuk kiicham jix búup gu suudai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal ka't gu o'o gu ñi'ook gu ux ju'ñdharan ka't maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan mii' dhɨr gook gu jodai' na jix uam maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' chɨkka tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu mar gu Joas tu' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ kiicham gui'p gu Joas.
Na gu' jix buusñi mai' gu mar na ba' gu jodai' na gu' tu' gu o'o jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baal tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux ju'ñdharan ka't.

Jano' ba' gu Joas jix aa' bɨx mi'p ju'ñdharan; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu Baal gu ñi'ook gu takarui' no'x jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu jodai' gu xibh; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ux bɨɨx jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jup tɨɨt gu chuukug gu Jerobaal; na gu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Baal bhaan jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Amalekitas gu jodai' jum daa'ñ bhɨi jix duñia' yooxi' gu ñi'ook gu Jesreel.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu chuukug na ja'p gu ux ka't dhaa gu suudai' gu Abieser jum daa'ñ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu takarui' gu ux bɨx gu Manasees gio jum daa'ñ bɨɨx; gio ba' gu suudai' bhañ gu takarui' gu Aser gu ñi'ook gu chuukug moor jix ai.
Ba' jix aa' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ux gu novɨ na ja'p tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu ja'tkam ka't; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu vaak gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jix gaki bɨx gu oidha' jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ux gu novɨ na ja'p tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't; na gu' na ja'p jix búup gu xibh gu takarui' gu vaak jix buusñi gu suudai' vaaso jix bhuup gu suudai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt daak bhaan tu' gu suudai' tu ñi'ook dhi' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu jodai' jano' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu vaak; jano' ba' jix duñia' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu suudai' bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' jix duñia' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak bɨx gu oidha' juruuñ gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh gu Jerobaal gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx jix duñia' yooxi' ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu arod; gio ba' ga'ra' yooxi' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ja'tkam gu More gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ja'tkam bɨndak jix jai' na ba' tu' jix maa gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ; na gu' cham gu takarui' gu Israeel bhaan tu' bham; jano' ba' gu novɨ tu' dodhia'.

Jano' ba' gu vupui jano' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham; na gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu jodai' dɨr gu kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr suulh gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug; gio ba' gu suudai' jix jai' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' gu jodai'; jano' ba' tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' bɨndak gu oi'ñga'n bɨndak; gu' no'x tu' gu takarui'; jano' ba' dhi' cham gu oi'ñga'n bɨndak jix duñia' cham gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu suudai'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr no'x gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' bɨɨx nɨɨn na ja'p gu ñi'ook gagai' gu bhóogɨt dɨlhkob; jano' ba' gu suudai' no'x jix duñia' bhaan kɨkbok na ba' i'i.
Jano' ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu novɨ gu chin vaik gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan kɨkbok na ba' i'i gu suudai'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug; gio ba' bɨɨx dhi' ja'tkam vaik gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' dodhia' kapbhai' gu bhóogɨt gu noobh; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n pai'.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu duukam na ba' gu ja'tkam gu noobh gu suudai' bhañ bɨx gu Israelitas maa'n vaak zel gu takarui' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam vaik gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' ga'ra' yooxi' gu Madiaan gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bamii' gu chuukug yooxi'; na gu' tu' dhagia' gu noobh.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook choo'n jix dhaav gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bɨɨx gu chuukug jix duñia' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' gu noobh jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n yooxi'; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav bɨɨx gu chuukug jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ka't yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu Madiaan gu Amalek bɨx gu jodai' mi'p gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix ai jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p oo' gu vaak gu gɨ' suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu suudai' gu chio'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook duiñchu' gu vaak bham; gio ba' gu Miren tu' gu jodai' gu vaak; na gu chuukug gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm yooxi' gu Madiaan jix duñia' vaak zel gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chuukug bhaan jiix gu i'ii'ñ vaak zel gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' duiñchu'; gio ba' dhi' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu kuchii gu chuukug gu mar gu Joas gu chio'ñ gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu noobh gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx bɨx yooxi'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Gedeoon jix kai gu tasi' gu vaak gu takarui' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt yooxi' gu Israeel jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' yooxi' gu Madiaan gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik gu chichio'ñ vaik gu chuukug jix maa maa'n gu suudai' gu noobh gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' xoi'kam na ja'p tu' gu oi'ñga'n; na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gɨ'kora' ja'tkam yooxi' na ja'p tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix duu gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu' kuichdha' gu chuukug bɨx no'm gu chuukug; gio ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' jano' ba' gu suudai' xikoolh bɨx yooxi' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' baidhak gɨ'kora' ja'tkam yooxi' ba'k jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu noobh.

Jano' ba' vaik gu chuukug jix duñia' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ gu noobh gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' a'aa' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix maa gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu kuchii gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt yooxi'; gio ba' bɨx yooxi' ka't gu jodai' na jix uam jiboi'ññor gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Gu' gu' vaik jix duñia' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu kuchii maa'n bhaan duiñchu' bɨx yooxi'; mi' dhɨr ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-sitta bhaan gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Abel-meola gu Tabbat.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel gu chuukug gu Aser bɨx gu Manasees bhiadat gu Madianitas.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gio bhañ gu takarui' bɨx gu kavɨk gu Epraim bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-bara gu Jordaan; mi' dhɨr tɨtda:―Aañ bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Epraim gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Bet-bara gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gook chiñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Oreb gu Seeb; gio ba' mu'aa gu Oreb jodai kavɨk gu Oreb gu Seeb mu'aa gu chuukug gu Seeb; mi' dhɨr bhiadat gu bhóogɨt aichdhak ɨɨbhidham gu Oreb gu Seeb gu chuukug baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim gui'p; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch cham jup tɨɨt na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Madiaan jix duñia' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jano' na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ cham gu maa'nkar gu Epraim tutkɨ gu takarui' gu Abieser.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu noobh gu Oreb gu Seeb chiñia' gu Madiaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' duñia' na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ jano' ba' gu duukam bhaan jix duñia' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu chuukug gu Jordaan na ba' gu ñi'ook vaik gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook baidhak gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Sukkot; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ jix maa gu ja'tkam gu takarui' dhɨt gu chin gu takarui'; na gu' gu jodai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Seba gu Salmunna gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Sukkot tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu novɨ gu Seba gu Salmunna gu novɨ na ba' gu ñi'ook no'ch gu chuukug gu takarui' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' gu chuukug; na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios ka't dhagia' gu novɨ gu Seba gu Salmunna tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug bɨɨx jo'ii' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oidha' jix gaki.
Ba' jix aa' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Penuel gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Penuel tu ñi'ook na ja'p a'ga gu Sukkot.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Penuel bham; na pai' dhuuk tu' gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu o'o dhi' bhi'ñbak.

Jano' ba' gu Seba gu Salmunna mi'p gu Karkor bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ja'p gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ bɨx gu suudai' jix duñia' bɨx yooxi' gu jodai'; gio ba' koko'kam gu suudai' jix duñia' chamaam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii.
Na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu chuukug bhaan oi'ñka' vaak zel baasɨ'n gu ux na tu ibai' gu Noba gu Jogbea naaka'n yooxi' na gu' ka't ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham cham gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Seba gu Salmunna chɨ'ɨɨk; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan gu Seba gu Salmunna jix duñia' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu mar gu Joas jix duñia' gu chuukug va'k gu tas jix tɨ'ɨ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' gu Sukkot tu ñi'ook jix maa gu ux ua'nak gu ñi'ook gu Sukkot daraa gu vaak kɨɨv gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' baakɨk gu Sukkot; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Seba gu Salmunna bhaan jix duñia' bham; mi' dhɨr tu' gu novɨ gu Seba gu Salmunna gu novɨ na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu takarui' gu chichio'ñ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ daraa kiicham jo'ii' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Sukkot.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' bhi'ñbak gu Penuel mu'aa kiicham.

Ba' jix aa' gu Seba gu Salmunna; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ ko'kmarak mii' dhɨr ja'tkam mu'aa gu Tabor tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu' gu takarui' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu naan; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n nukadham gu oidha' tu' cham kooda'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeter maa'nkam mar; gio ba' bamii' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu' gu vaak cham jix duñia' gu kuchii na gu' ga'ra' choo'n; na gu suudai' ka't gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Seba gu Salmunna; gio ba' bamii' tu' gu chuukug; na gu' na ja'p gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu suudai'; jano' ba' gu Gedeoon jix búup mu'aa gu Seba gu Salmunna; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix ai jix duñia' baakux.
Jano' ba' gu Israelitas gui'p gu chuukug; gio ba' tu' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan tu' gu mar gu ja'tkam; na gu' gu takarui' gu novɨ gu Madiaan.
Gu' gu' gu chuukug jix aa'; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' gu mar aapi'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ maa'n jix maa gu takarui'; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' jix uam jodai jix duñia' gu Ismaelitas; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' maa'n gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix uam jodai jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt jajannulhi'ñ ñakaabma' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan cham gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt jix ai baakux.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug gu ñi'ook nukadham kiicham gu Opra; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel jix duñia' bhaan gu takarui' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr pai'; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ux gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't jix duñia' gu Madiaan vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n jix búup mo'o; gio ba' jix utu'ñ gu oidha' oo'm gu takarui' gu tanoolh gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu mar gu Joas ka't jix daa gu vaak.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu vaak gu ma'nkam moor gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' jix duñia' mumua'da' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ ka't gu bhóogɨt gio jix duñia' gu mar; gio ba' jix dhaas gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Abimelek.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu chuukug gu mar gu Joas jix bhai' gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' tukga'n gu taat gu Joas gu Opra gu Abieseritas.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix koi gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Baales jix dhaas gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu Baal-berit.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu takarui' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ xikoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duu xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu vaak gu Jerobaal gu chuukug jurtu'nka' bɨx xoi'kam ka't gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' ka't gu Abimelek gu mar gu Jerobaal gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu naan bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu vaak gu taat gu naan bham.

Jano' ba' tu' soi'ñ tu ñi'ook maatɨt bɨx gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook namki' gu ñi'ook tutkɨ jix gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu chichio'ñ bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Jerobaal; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix duñia' o'o gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ux gu ja'tkam gu naan maatɨt bɨx gu bhóogɨt bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ux gu Abimelek na gu' am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu vaak gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal-berit bɨɨx gu Abimelek gu kutun gu chichio'ñ jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook bhiadat.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu vaak gu taat gu Opra mu'aa xibhɨk gu ma'nkam gu Jerobaal gu vaak gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu jodai; gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jotam gu oi'ñga'n jix ali' gu mar gu Jerobaal jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx bɨx gu vaak gu kutun jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' gu Abimelek gu ux gu gɨ'kora' mia'n gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p tu ñi'ook gu Jotam ka't jix dhaas gu ux gu kavɨk gu Gerisim gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt; na gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu u'u gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gui'p gu suudai'; gio ba' gu Reina bhaan no'ch.
Gu' gu' gu suudai' jix aa'; gio ba' no'ñ mi'x dhaas gu jodai' gu kutun bɨɨx gu ux kuiñcha gu Jawatan Dios gu chichio'ñ nɨidhat gu ux tu' gu suudai' jix gɨ' bhaan gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu u'u iigɨx; gio ba' jiim tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix aa' iigɨx; gio ba' no'ñ mi'x dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' gu i'bhɨ gu ux tu' gu suudai' jix gɨ' bhaan gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu u'u gu tasi'; na gu' gu kutun tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' jix aa'; gio ba' no'ñ mi'x dhaas gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu chichio'ñ gu ux tu' gu suudai' jix gɨ' bhaan gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gui'p jano' ba' bɨx gu u'u gu jodai'; gio ba' jiim tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' jix aa' gu u'u; gio ba' tu' tu'r gu takarui' gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n ɨkgiga'n; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu tai gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu takarui' gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' tu' bɨɨx tu'r bɨɨx gu suudai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Abimelek tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam bɨɨx gu Jerobaal bɨɨx gu vaak tu' jix duñia' gu chuukug jurtu'nka' tu duukam gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu taat gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' gu oidha' gu ux jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Madiaan.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix búup gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaak gu taat mu'aa gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu jodai; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu Abimelek gu mar gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios na gu' xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx tu'r bɨɨx gu suudai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jerobaal bɨɨx gu vaak gu chuukug gu Abimelek gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tai gu ñi'ook gu Abimelek jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu kutun; gio ba' gu tai gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu kutun jix duñia' gu Abimelek.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jotam jix duñia' ka't gu Beer juruuñ gu ux kuiñcha gu Abimelek xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Abimelek ka't gu suudai' bhaan gu Israeel vaik gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ cham bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Abimelek gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt; na gu bhóogɨt jix búup bhaan gu Abimelek.
Na ba' na ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu ma'nkam gu Jerobaal gu ɨ'ɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix dhaas bhaan gu Abimelek xibhɨk mu'aa bhaan gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu noobh na ba' kooda' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu ux gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Abimelek.
Jano' ba' gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed suudai' u'va bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gamai' yooxi' gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix duu gu suudai'; gio ba' baakɨk vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios koi'mɨk i'i gu takarui' gu Abimelek.

Ba' jix aa' gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed; gio ba' chɨkka gu Abimelek gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na ba' no'ch gu jodai' cham gu mar gu Jerobaal cham gu Sebul gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu taat gu bhóogɨt; gu' gu ñi'ook dua'ñ tu juan.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix maa dhi' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu novɨ tu' mi'x juu'ñ gu Abimelek; gio ba' chɨtda gu Abimelek; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu chuukug jix buus.
Jano' ba' gu Sebul gu ñi'ook kiicham tɨiñ gu ñi'ook gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed gu tai daak.
Jano' ba' bhañ jix bhai'x gu takarui' gu Abimelek bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tɨbiap gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix duñia' mia'n kiicham bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' bamii' jano' gu tukaa' tu' gu ja'tkam bɨndak gu takarui' gu maa'nkar yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu xibh jix buus gu tas tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug kiicham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jix duu bɨɨx bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu tukaa' gu Abimelek bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't jix dhaas gu maa'nkar bhaan gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx maakobh jugi.
Jano' ba' gu Gaal gu mar gu Ebed jix buus jix dhaas ba'k ki'ñgob kiicham; gio ba' gu Abimelek bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't jix búup gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Gaal gu ja'tkam gu Sebul; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu kakkavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Sebul jix aa'; jano' ba' ɨkgiga'n gu kakkavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Gaal jix duñia' ñiokda'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Sebul jix aa'; gio ba' duukat jano' mii' dhɨr ñiokda' bham; mi' dhɨr chɨkka gu Abimelek na ba' gu jodai' cham dhi' gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' jix buus jano' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Gaal jix buus vupui bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu ux bhaan gu Abimelek.
Gu' gu' jix duñia' gu Abimelek vupui bhaan jix duñia'; gio ba' ia'rɨ gu chuukug mui'x bɨɨx ka'm ba'k ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu Abimelek jix duñia' gu Aruma; gio ba' gu Sebul mi'x juu'ñ mai' gu Gaal gu ja'tkam na ba' cham jix koi gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ka't buimgidhak gu tanoolh gu ja'tkam jix buus yooxi'; gio ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Abimelek.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu ja'tkam jix duñia' vaik jugi jix dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi'; gio ba' na ja'p jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam busaak kiicham; mi' dhɨr jix búup bhaan naaka'n.
Na gu' gu Abimelek gu suudai' ka't bɨɨx jix duñia' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ba'k ki'ñgob kiicham; gio ba' gook jugi jix duñia' bɨx mi'p yooxi' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jugi gu Abimelek kiicham bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bhɨɨ mu'aa gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' kiicham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu chuukug dhi' bɨx mi'p bhi'ñbak gu bhóogɨt baap gu kavɨk vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Abimelek na ja'p bɨx bhi'ñbak gu bhóogɨt mi'p gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Abimelek gu kavɨk gu Salmoon bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Abimelek gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu ñi'ook gu ux gu u'u gu bhóogɨt jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook bham gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr gu kutun tu' gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam gu takarui' jix bhai'x na ja'p tu'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gio maa'n gu ux bhiadat gu Abimelek jix dhaas ju'ñdharan gu kavɨk jix duñia' gu tai bɨɨx gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu ux bɨx bhi'ñbak gu bhóogɨt jix koko' na ja'p jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Abimelek ka't gu Tebes; gio ba' jix dhaas jix duñia' gu Tebes jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr kiicham ka't bhi'ñbak jix kavɨk jix duñia' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ bɨx gu Jawatan kiicham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan kiki'ñgob jix tɨ'ɨ gu suudai' jix bhai'x bhi'ñbak.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Abimelek bhi'ñbak jugi jix duñia' ki'ñgob bhi'ñbak na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tai.
Gu' gu' gu u'vɨ mi'x dhaas gu chuukug jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan mo'o gu Abimelek jix duñia' gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt kutun kavɨk; na gu' jix buusñi gu kuchii gu ñi'ook na gu' cham gu takarui' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ mu'aa; jano' ba' kutun kavɨk jix duñia' jix koi.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Israelitas jix duñia' jix koi gu Abimelek jix bɨɨx duu maa'n gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abimelek cham bhai' bhaan gu taat mu'aa gu vaak gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨx cham bhai' gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ɨɨbhidham; gio ba' mu'ai gu Jotam gu mar gu Jerobaal suudai' u'va bhaan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Abimelek jix búup na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel gu Tola gu mar gu Puua gu mar gu Dodo gu chio'ñ gu Issakâr jix daa gu Samir gu kavɨk gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' jix koi ka't jix duñia' gu Samir.
Jano' ba' bhaan jix búup gu Jair gu duukam gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook ko'kmarak gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Jair ka't jix duñia' gu Kamoon.

Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Baales gu Astarot gu Jawatan Dios gu Siria gu Jawatan Dios gu Sidoon gu Jawatan Dios gu Moab gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Jawatan Dios gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhaan gu Israeel jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi'p baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Amorreo gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan na ba' gu chuukug gio bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Judaa bhaan gu Benjamiin gu vaak gu Epraim; gio ba' ka't gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' no'ch gu jodai' uañi'ñ bhaan tu'; na gu' gu jodai' tɨtda:―Cha'pim chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Baales.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Ejipto gu Amorreos gu Ammonitas gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gu Sidoon gu Amalek gu Maoon jiiñkɨk tu' gu takarui' gu noobh.
Gu' gu' gu takarui' jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ duuñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tasi' namkidhat gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu jodai' uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu vupui tu' bɨɨx no'ch na ja'p xoi'kam tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu suudai' jano' jix duñia' dhi' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu oi'ñga'n kuiñcha tu jiim gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jix duñia' yooxi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jum daa'ñ gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' yooxi' gu Mispa.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gui'p maa'n; gio ba' chɨkka ka't kua'da' gu chuukug bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ka't mo'o bhaan bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' ba' gu Jeptee gu duukam gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk gu mar ganai' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu duukam.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gio ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam; na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu mi'x juu'ñ mai' gu Jeptee tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu taat na gu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Jeptee kuiñcha gu ja'tkam jix daa gu oidha' gu Tob; gio ba' jum daa'ñ bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ jix bhai'x bɨɨx jix buus.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jix duu bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt ko'kmarak bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Israeel daraa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bɨɨx duu na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jeptee gu oidha' gu Tob.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu jodai'; gio ba' gu kutun ka' chulhiiñdha' gu suudai' na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jeptee jix aa' daraa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na pai' dhuuk cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' mi'x juu'ñ gu vaak gu taat gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n jano' tu' na pai' dhuuk gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' daraa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jeptee; gio ba' gu ux dhi' kuiñcha gu oi'ñga'n jano' tu' na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch gu ux bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu ñi'ook mo'o bɨx jix koi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeptee jano' ba' daraa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' na ba' gu suudai' bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' vupui bhaan tu' jix duñia' tu' mo'o.
Jano' ba' daraa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jeptee; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch tu' cham jix duu na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jeptee suudai' u'va bɨɨx daraa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ux mo'o gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Jeptee tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jeptee gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu Ammonitas bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug tɨbiap tu' na ba' bhaan bhɨɨ'ñdham gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ammonitas jix aa' gu chuukug gu Jeptee; na pai' dhuuk na gu' gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto dɨr gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Jabok gu Jordaan; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt jano' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jeptee jix duñia' tɨip gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu Ammonitas.
Na ba' na ba' a'ga; gio ba' gu Jeptee tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel cham jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' gu Moab tu' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Gu' gu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Israeel gu Ejipto jix jiim gu ux oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Kades.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Israeel bhañ gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu Edom bham; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Edom cham jix duñia'; jano' ba' bhañ gio gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab; gio ba' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu Israeel gu Kades.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jiimchu' gu ux oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Edom pai' gu Moab bai'ñpu' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' pai' gu Moab jix duñia' yooxi' dhi' baasɨ'n gu Arnoon cham baap gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Moab; na gu' gu Arnoon gu ñi'ook gu Moab.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Israeel gu chuukug gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm pai'.
Gu' gu' gu kutun cham jix duñia' gu Israeel na ba' jix duu gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' va'k gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun bɨx gu ja'tkam jix dhaas yooxi' gu Jaas gu ux bhaan gu Israeel.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel do'ñcho gu kutun bɨx gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Israeel jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Israeel bɨx gu oidha' gu Amorreo jix daa mii' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gio bɨx gu ñi'ook xoi'kam dɨr gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Jabok dɨr oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm gu Jordaan.
Na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel mi'x juu'ñ gu Amorreos vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios tu' mi'x juu'ñ oi'ñdha' cham bia'ka' tu' bia'ka' no'ch bɨx mii' dhɨr mi'x juu'ñ gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug tu' jano' gu ñi'ook tutkɨ gu Balak gu mar gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Israeel bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Israeel tu' dhi' jix daa gu ñi'ook vaik gu takarui' gu esboon taañpu' gu Aroer taañpu' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Arnoon gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' tu' cham tu' uañi'ñ bhaan tu' gu' tu' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu chuukug bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jir bɨx bhai' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon cham jix duñia' gu jodai' gu Jeptee bhañ.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Jeptee; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Manasees; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Mispa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu Mispa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jeptee gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tu' kapbhai' gu Ammonitas gu noobh.
Na pai' dhuuk no'x gu ñi'ook gu takarui' kiki'ñgob gu vaak na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Ammonitas bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jeptee gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon na ba' gu ux bhaan; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gu chuukug gu takarui' dɨr gu Aroer bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug gu Minnit gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ammonitas vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jeptee gu Mispa gu vaak gu suudai' mar u'vɨ jix buus gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu duukam gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; gio ba' cham ga'ra' mai' gu mar tu' mar u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix ñi' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'r jix duñia' tu' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' tu' jix kupi'ook gu chin gu Jawatan Dios cham gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu taat gu chuukug tu' jix kupi'ook gu chin gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui tu' na ja'p jix buus gu chin gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ obhɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' a'ga gu taat; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n dhi'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu ux gook masaa'n gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ux gu kakkavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr mi'x dhaas gu ux gook masaa'n; jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx gu duukam gu ñi'ook gu ux gu kakkavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oi'ñga'n gook masaa'n jix duñia' gu taat jurtu'nka' gu tasi' ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu takarui' gu Israeel oi'ñga' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt mar u'vɨ gu Jeptee gu duukam maakobh gu tanoolh oi'ñga'.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ gu Epraim gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gui'p gu Jeptee; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon cham mɨmɨim na ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨndak no'ch gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tai gu vaak bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu Jeptee jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jup tɨɨt cham jix duñia' gu noobh.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu novɨ; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' na ba' gu ux gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jeptee bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux bhaan gu Epraim; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu Epraim na gu' gu suudai' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Epraim gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Epraim gu Manasees.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Jordaan gu Epraim; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu Epraim ka't jix duñia' chɨtda gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug tu' gu Eprateo tu' tu ñi'ook cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' jano' tu' gu Sibolet; mi' dhɨr chɨtda gu Sibolet; na gu' cham gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ gu novɨ gu tasi' ju'ñdharan gu suudai' gu Jordaan; mi' dhɨr jix koko' jano' ba' gu Epraim oo'm gook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu Jeptee gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ux gu takarui'; gio ba' jix koi gu Jeptee gu duukam ka't jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh gu duukam.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu Ibsan gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix duñia' mai' jix bhɨɨ mai' gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na ba' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel kɨɨv gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Ibsan ka't jix duñia' gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu Eloon gu ñi'ook gu Israeel mambhɨɨx gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Eloon gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu Abdoon gu mar gu illel gu Piratonita.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' oo'm gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan gu vaak gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu tasi' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Abdoon gu mar gu illel gu Piratonita ka't jix duñia' gu Piratoon gu oidha' gu Epraim gu kavɨk gu Amalek.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu novɨ gu Pilisteos gu ux oo'm gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Sora bopxi'ñ gu Dan jup tɨɨt gu Manoa; gio ba' gu u'vɨ ka't gu ñi'ook cham pai' dhuuk ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu u'vɨ jix ñi'ñ nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt; gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu mar.
Jano' ba' jano' gu suudai' jano' cham i'i suudai' u'va tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.

Na gu' na gu' tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu mar; na gu' cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu takarui' bhaan mo'o na gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu Nasareo gu Jawatan Dios dɨr vook kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ suudai' u'va jix duñia' gu chio'ñ bham; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va tu' gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu ñi'ook duukat tu' chɨkka ka't tu' gu suudai' jix aa' gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu mar; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' jano' cham i'i suudai' u'va tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; na gu' dhi' gu ñi'ook dɨr vook ka't gu Nasareo gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh koi'm.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Manoa gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu chuukug tu' soi'ñ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jano' jix ai no'ch gu chuukug gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' maaxilhia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu ñi'ook gu Manoa; gio ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu u'vɨ kua' yooxi'; gu' gu chio'ñ gu Manoa cham ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ dai'bus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu chio'ñ tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ suudai' u'va tu' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Manoa chɨ'ɨɨk gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug tu' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ jix aa'; jano' ba' tu' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Manoa; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Manoa; gio ba' gu u'vɨ nukadham bɨx tu'x tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' jix maa suudai' u'va; gio ba' cham i'i suudai' u'va tu' gu oi'ñga'n cham jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; mi' dhɨr tu' nukadham bɨx jix aa'ñdhix.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Manoa nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' vupui bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Manoa; gio ba' gu ux gu bhóogɨt cham jugi gu takarui'; gu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' cham bhai'x gu Manoa gu bhóogɨt jum duu nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Manoa nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Manoa jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt gu o'o maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan jodai kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' nobii'ñ jix duu gu ux ñiata gu Manoa gu u'vɨ.

Na gu' na gu' ka't na ja'p mɨmɨim jix tɨ'ɨ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu tɨkɨr nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ mɨmɨim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ñiata gu Manoa gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Manoa tu' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Manoa ka't nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu novɨ gu u'vɨ; na gu' gu ñi'ook koi na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' buupui.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' kooda' cham jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu noobh maa'nkar tai bhaan gu o'o tu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bɨx dhi' tu'x tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Samsoon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' aa'.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios kua'da' gu jodai' vaak ja'tkam gu Dan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sora gu Estaol.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Samsoon gu Timna jix ñi' gu Timna gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu taat gu naan bham; gio ba' tu' buupui gu Timna gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' gu taat gu naan gui'p; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ja'tkam tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gu Samsoon jix aa' gu taat; na gu' gu jodai' gu ux gu u'vɨ na gu' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu vupui.
Gu' gu' gu taat gu naan cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bua' bhaan gu Pilisteos; na gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos jix duñia' bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Samsoon jix dhaav bɨɨx gu taat bɨɨx gu naan gu Timna; gio ba' na ja'p jix duñia' oidha' u'va gu Timna gu suudai' gu chuukug maavɨt gu jodai' bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhaan jix duñia' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt cham mambhɨɨx cham tu' gu novɨ; gio ba' cham jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu taat tu' gu naan ka't gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu u'vɨ ka't jix duñia' gu Samsoon.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr dhɨt gu tanoolh na ba' jix bhɨɨ jix ai'chdhix na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug jix koi maavɨt gu suudai' gu chuukug maavɨt ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug gu jodai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu noobh ka't jugi gu ux gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu taat gu naan jix maa gio jugi; gu' cham jix ñi'ñ ka't jix bhɨɨ mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu chuukug maavɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu suudai' u'va gu taat gu u'vɨ gu Samsoon gu takarui'; na gu' gu tas bhaan biipibop.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook jugi gu suudai' bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samsoon; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook jano' gu ñi'ook tu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jajannulhi'ñ.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' jugi jix buus jugi jix kavɨk jix buus gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gui'p gu u'vɨ gu Samsoon; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook na gu' cham tu' gu jodai' tu' gu vaak gu taat; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨgim na ba' bia'ka'.

Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu Samsoon vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu taat tu' gu naan jix duñia'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan kɨɨv gu tanoolh chooto'n gu takarui'; na gu' gu' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook na gu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh va'k gu tas jix dhaas kiicham gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk maavɨt.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' cham gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhaan jix dhaav gu i'ii'ñ naaka'n gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' dhaagɨk gu takarui' jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jajannulhi'ñ gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu duukam ka't gu vaak gu taat; jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu vaak ka't gu jodai' duiñchu' bɨɨx va'k jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook oraa' tiriik gu Samsoon jix duñia' gu u'vɨ bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt bham; gio ba' ba'k gu u'vɨ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gu' gu taat cham mi'x dhaas baakɨi.
Ba' jix aa' gu taat; gio ba' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' duiñchu'; gu' gu ja'tkam jix ali' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu ñi'ook pai'.
Jano' ba' gu Samsoon jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook dhi' jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx gu Pilisteos tu' cham bhai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Samsoon jix duñia' vaik gu takarui' dhaagɨk gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu jodai' jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt mi'x juu'ñ gu takarui' ko'iim gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu suudai' gu novɨ oidha' u'va gu kutun.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu Pilisteos; gio ba' chɨkka jix duu dhi' ka't tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Samsoon gu takarui' gu Timnateo na gu' jix duñia' gu u'vɨ jix maa duiñchu'; jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gu tai gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samsoon; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx jix koi; gio ba' jix dhaav jix duñia' jumpa'n gu jodai' na jix uam gu Etam.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jix tɨ'ɨ jix dhaas yooxi' gu Judaa jix duñia' gu ux gu Lei.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa gui'p; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan no'ch tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu Samsoon gu jodai' jix tɨ'ɨ na ba' duñia' na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa jumpa'n gu jodai' na jix uam gu Etam gui'p gu Samsoon; gio ba' cham ñɨidhat tu' gu Pilisteos gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan no'ch gu ux gu ñi'ook dhi' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix duu.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' no'ch gu jodai' tɨbiap na ba' gu oi'ñga'n kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr gu Samsoon jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' cham yaa'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' cham gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' tu' kapbhai' gu noobh; gu' cham tu' kooda'; jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gook gu suudai' jix vɨɨk jix duu gu kutun gu jodai' na jix uam.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm gu Lei gu Pilisteos moor gu takarui' bɨɨx gu suudai'; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhaan gu suudai' mi'p gu novɨ jix duñia' na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug bɨɨx gu tai gu ñi'ook ia'rɨ gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix duñia' gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ naaka'n bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Samsoon; gio ba' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gook gɨ' kavɨk; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' a'gidhimɨk ñiokda' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu bhóogɨt jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr pai' gu Ramat-lei.
Ba' jix aa' da'p gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' jix maa dhi' tulhiiñdha' gu ux gu novɨ tu duukam; mi' dhɨr koi tu' jano' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt ka't gu bhóogɨt moor gu suudai' jix i'i jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia'; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu En-akkore gu Lei bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu tanoolh gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Samsoon gu Gasa jix ñi' gu u'vɨ ganai' chɨbiapui.

Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Gasa; gio ba' gu Samsoon tɨbiap jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' ki'ñgob kiicham; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' bham; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tasi' gu xibh; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' kooda'.

Gu' gu' gu Samsoon jix koox bɨɨx ka'm ɨraab gu tukaa'; gio ba' ɨraab gu tukaa' jix búup dhaagɨk kiki'ñgob kiicham bɨɨx gook gu ñi'ook gu vupui mi'x juu'ñ gu oi'ñga'n ka't jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gu ux gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu suudai' gu Sorek jup tɨɨt gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs chiñia' gu Pilisteos gui'p; gio ba' gu Engaañale gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu chuukug na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr maa'n no'ch tu' maa'n jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Samsoon; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu suudai' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu suudai' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Samsoon; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' bɨɨx kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' na ja'p no'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Pilisteos aichdhak kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' cham gu suudai' gu takarui' jix duñia' bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' mi'p gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; na pai' dhuuk gu Samsoon gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu suudai' gu ñi'ook dhi' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tai; jano' ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Samsoon; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu suudai' tu ñi'ook tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt jano' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' jix bhai'x bɨɨx gu suudai' jix vɨɨk bɨɨx matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug jix duñia' na ja'p no'x gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' jix vɨɨk jix duñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' gu Samsoon gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook mi'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gu' jix duñia' gu novɨ na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Samsoon; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm jano' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu chuukug bɨɨx tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu Deskuubreme jano' gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' kɨɨv gu chuukug mo'o bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' dhi'; gio ba' gu Samsoon gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' gu' gu ñi'ook koox jix duñia' dhi' gu takarui' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ cham gu chuukug tu' gu suudai' vaik mui'kim cham gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix koi gu chuukug.

Ba' jix aa' jix ñi'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk mo'o jix duñia' gu takarui'; na gu' jix duñia' gu Nasareo gu Jawatan Dios dɨr vook gu naan; jano' ba' tu' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk jix bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p bɨx gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n ka't jix duñia' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bhañ tɨɨt chiñia' gu Pilisteos bham; na gu' gu bhóogɨt dhi' jix duñia' na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr chiñia' gu Pilisteos tɨɨtɨs jix duñia' gu novɨ tuumiñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan kɨkbok; gio ba' tɨɨgim gu chio'ñ jix duñia' kɨɨv gu chuukug mo'o kua'da' tu jiim gu kavɨk jix ai'chdhix.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Samsoon gu Pilisteos bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook koox jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' jix duñia' gu jodai' na ja'p gu suudai'; jano' ba' cham pu'ñir gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu vaak.
Gu' gu' gu Pilisteos mi'x juu'ñ gu novɨ jix duñia' gu vupui bhɨɨk gu Gasa; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kuupa'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mo'o kua'da' gu takarui' mi' dhɨr ka't gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' gu Pilisteos jum daa'ñ na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu Dagoon gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu Dios gu noobh gu Samsoon chulhiiñdha' bhaamki'ñdha'.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu Dios gu noobh chulhiiñdha' bhaamki'ñdha' gu takarui' gu kutun gu oidha' ka't jix koi mui'x no'ch.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gui'p; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu Samsoon na ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr tɨɨt gu Samsoon kuupa' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan; jano' ba' jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Samsoon gu takarui' jix duñia' gu novɨ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vaak zel gu vaak bhaan jix duñia' gu vaak na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu vaak ka't jix bhuup gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ; gio ba' bɨx chiñia' gu Pilisteos mi'p; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x gu suudai' ka't na ja'p vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ mi'p tɨɨgɨk gu duukam gu Samsoon.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Samsoon gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' jano' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' soi'ñ gu suudai' dhi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gook gu vupui.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Samsoon gook gu vaak tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan jix duñia' gu vaak jix duñia' bɨɨx gu novɨ tu jiim bɨɨx o'nsop.

Ba' jix aa' gu Samsoon; gio ba' gu jodai' tu' bɨɨx gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr gu o'o bɨɨx gu suudai' jix duñia' gu vaak bhaan chiñia' bhaan bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't; jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu mui'x gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' vaak jodai ka't jix koi gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu ja'tkam bɨx gu vaak gu taat jix bhɨɨ bhɨɨk gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sora gu Estaol tukga'n gu taat gu Manoa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu kavɨk gu Epraim jup tɨɨt gu Mikâs.

Ba' jix aa' gu naan; gio ba' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai tu' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu ux tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' tu' gu suudai' tu' no'ñ dhi' tuumiñ; mi' dhɨr tu' ka't jix bhɨɨ; jano' ba' gu naan jix aa'; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu mar gu chuukug.

Ba' jix aa' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu naan jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai gu naan; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' dhi' tuumiñ gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ na ba' tu' gu mar gu chuukug na ba' gu ñi'ook na jax chu'm jix duñia' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr jano' tu' gu jodai'.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu naan gu jodai' jix bhɨɨ gu naan gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai jix maa gu suudai'; gio ba' jix duu na jax chu'm jix duñia' tu jiim ka't jix duñia' gu vaak gu Mikâs.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' dhi' gu chio'ñ gu Mikâs gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu jodai' jix duñia' maa'n gu ma'nkam; gio ba' ka't gu ux jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' maa'n jix duñia' na ja'p tutkɨ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ka't gu vaak gu Bet-leem gu Judaa bopxi'ñ gu Judaa ka't gu Lebita; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu chio'ñ ka't gu suudai' kiicham gu Bet-leem gu Judaa na ba' tu' duaka' pai' bakia'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu kavɨk gu Epraim suudai' u'va gu vaak gu Mikâs na ba' duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikâs; gio ba' duukat gu jodai' gu Lebita jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Bet-leem gu Judaa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ duaka' pai' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Mikâs; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' gu vaak ka' pai' gu taat jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai gu ux oidha' tas gu bhóogɨt jajannulhi'ñ jugi; jano' ba' gu Lebita jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tɨ'ñcho gu i'ii'ñ jix koi bɨɨx mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ga'ra' na ja'p maa'n gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu Mikâs jix duñia' gu Lebita mii' dhɨr gu vaak gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't gu vaak gu Mikâs.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikâs; gio ba' jano' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Lebita gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; na gu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar na ba' pai' jix koi na gu' bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba' cham ka't gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu ux gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan mɨjɨ bopxi'ñ jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk gu Sora gu Estaol na ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam gu oidha'; gio ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu oidha'; jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam tɨɨtɨs gu kavɨk gu Epraim bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu Mikâs gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p mi'p mia'n gu vaak gu Mikâs gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Lebita; gio ba' jimɨɨk gui'p; mi' dhɨr chɨkka tu' gu jodai' gu ux jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook tu' gu ux.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Mikâs tu' jix bhɨɨ na ba' ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jano' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook xoi'kam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' tɨɨtɨs gu Lais; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix daa ka't gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu suudai' jurtu'nka' gu takarui' gu Sidoon; mi' dhɨr cham ka't soo'mchulhdhak mii' dhɨr jix suudai' duu gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr dhi'; jano' ba' gu jodai' dhi' mi'p gu suudai' gu Sidonios cham ko'kmarak gu takarui' bɨɨx soo'mchulhdhak.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu Sora gu Estaol gu ja'tkam gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan; na gu' no'ch gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix suudai' duu gu jodai' buupui gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt cham ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug aajim gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu ux gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu takarui' tu' dhagia' gu noobh; mi' dhɨr pai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch uañi'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Dan gu Sora gu Estaol gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' yooxi' gu oi'ñga'n gu Judaa; gio ba' pai' mii' dhɨr pai' ka't tɨɨgim yooxi' gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bhɨi gu kavɨk gu Epraim tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu Mikâs.
