Jano' ba' jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu Lais gui'p gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p dhi' gu vaak cham tu'x jai'ch gu suudai' gu jodai' na jax chu'm jix duñia' gu takarui' gu suudai' jix duñia' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jimɨɨk tɨɨtɨs gu vaak gu Lebita gu vaak gu Mikâs tɨkka gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Dan mi'p gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham ba'k ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jixchamaam gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' baap jix bhɨɨ na jax chu'm jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jax chu'm gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ba'k ki'ñgob bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' baakɨk mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu vaak gu Mikâs jix bhɨɨ na jax chu'm jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jax chu'm gu takarui'; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug jix dhaas gu novɨ bhaan gu chin gu jodai' bɨɨx no'ch na ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu taat jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tutkɨ gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu vaak gu chio'ñ gu duukam bopxi'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' dhaagɨk gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jax chu'm suudai' u'va tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' jix dhaas a'aalh gu vaakax gu jodai' vupui bhaan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Mikâs gu chichio'ñ oi'ñka' gu vaak mia'n gu vaak gu Mikâs jum daa'ñ bhiadat gu ma'nkam gu Dan.
Jano' ba' jix maa jiiñak gu Dan suulhgia' suulh gu vupui gui'p gu Mikâs; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux na tu ibai' bɨɨma'n bɨɨx jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan gui'p; gio ba' cham gu chuukug jiiñak bhaan no'ch cham ka't gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gio gu oidha' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu bhóogɨt ñɨi'ñ gu Mikâs jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk jix duñia' jix suudai' duu gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu'x ka't gu ñi'ook gu Mikâs bɨɨma'n bɨɨx jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ga'ra' jix duñia' gu Lais gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' kiicham bɨɨx gu tai.
Na gu' cham ka't gu chuukug na gu' mi'p gu suudai' gu Sidoon cham ko'kmarak jugi bɨɨx soo'mchulhdhak; gio ba' kiicham ka't gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch gu Bet-reob; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' kiicham jix daa.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr kiicham gu Dan jurtu'nka' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dan gu taat gu mar gu Israeel xoi'kam va'k tɨɨt kiicham gu Lais.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan jix búup na jax chu'm jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Jonataan gu mar gu Gersoon gu mar gu Manasees gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bopxi'ñ gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix búup na jax chu'm gu Mikâs ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios juruuñ gu Silo.

Na pai' dhuuk mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't gu Lebita gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu kavɨk gu Epraim ka't jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu Bet-leem gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix duñia' bhaan jum duu gu vaak gu taat gu Bet-leem gu Judaa juruuñ gu ux gu ñi'ook maakobh masaa'n.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu chio'ñ chɨ'ɨɨk na ba' ñiokda' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu suudai' baidhak jix duñia' gu kutun gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' jimchu' gu taat gu bhóogɨt jix buus gu takarui' jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jir bɨx bhai' gu taat gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu vaak vaik gu tanoolh jugi i'i gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' maakobh gu tanoolh na ja'p jix búup gu xibh jix búup gio gu i'ii'ñ na ba' jix duu gu taat gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu chin gu takarui' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix dhadhaa gook tɨtda:―Aañ koi'mɨk i'i; gio ba' gu taat gu bhóogɨt jix aa' gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt dhi' gu tukaa' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu chio'ñ na ba' jix duu jir bɨx bhai' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu tukaa'.

Ba' jix aa' jixchamaam gu tanoolh kɨkbo gu xibh na ba' jix duu gu taat gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu chuukug jano' gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr dhaibu jugi gu ñi'ook gook jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm tu' jix duñia' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu chio'ñ na ba' jix duu gu u'vɨ jix duñia'; gio ba' jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' gu taat gu bhóogɨt jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' gu tas jix duñia' gu tukaa'; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu tanoolh jix duñia' mambhɨɨx gu tukaa' na ba' jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu xibh jix búup gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' vaak zel.
Gu' gu' gu chio'ñ cham gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook jix búup ta'tak jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Jebus gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' kua' tu' ju'ñdharan gu Jebus gu tanoolh ka't gu suudai' jix jai'; gio ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu kutun jano' gu chuukug dhi' kiicham gu Jebuseos na ba' gu chuukug gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu takarui' matgɨm kiicham jix bhai'x cham ka't gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr va'k gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug; jano' ba' jix aa' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu suudai' maa'n jix duñia' pai' na ba' mambhɨɨx gu tukaa' gu chuukug gu Rama.
Jano' ba' bhɨi jix duñia' jix dhaas gu tas ju'ñdharan gu chuukug ka't gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na ba' baakɨi mambhɨɨx gu tukaa' gu chuukug; na gu' baakɨk jix dhadhaa ɨrban kiicham na gu' cham ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak na ba' gu chuukug gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x gu xumai gu jodai' yooxi' gu chuukug; gio ba' ka't gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix duñia' gu chuukug gu' jix koi mii' dhɨr pai' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu vupui jix ñi' mii' dhɨr gu jodai' ɨrban kiicham; gio ba' duukat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ duukat gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu Bet-leem gu Judaa gu oi'ñga'n gu kavɨk gu Epraim pai' tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-leem gu Judaa; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu ux no'ch tañia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jugi na ba' gu ñi'ook gio tañia' gu takarui' suudai' u'va na ba' tu' na ba' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios na ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx tu duukam; gio ba' cham tu' tañia' uañi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka't bɨndak; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨx ka't gu suudai' gu chuukug bɨɨx jix duñia' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tukaa' ɨrban.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu vaak jix maa jugi gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' tɨɨt koi'mɨk i'i.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk mi'p gu jodai' gu suudai' gu chichio'ñ mii' dhɨr kiicham gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mia'n gu vaak gu bhóogɨt kiki'ñgob bham gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu vaak; gio ba' jix buusñi mai' gu chio'ñ tu' kia'mi'ñ gu vaak na ba' gu jodai'.

Ba' jix aa' gamai' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu takarui' gu vaak; gio ba' cham gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n cham jugi dhi' cham bhai' dhi' gu chio'ñ tu' kia'mi'ñ gu vaak cham xoi'kam dhi' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' mar u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' tu' jix buusñi jano'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook xoi'kam bɨɨx na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham xoi'kam dhi' gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ux dhaagɨk mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ jix buusñi mai'; na pai' dhuuk bhaan jix maati' jix duñia' bɨx gu tukaa' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh mi'x dhaas na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ suudai' u'va jix duñia' vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu vaak mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ pai' gu Jawatan ka't bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh gu Jawatan jix kupi'ook kiki'ñgob gu vaak jix buus na ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu u'vɨ ka't gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan ki'ñgob gu vaak bɨɨx gu noobh bhaan gu kutun.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Lebaantate gu chuukug; gu' cham jix aa'; jano' ba' jix búup gu chio'ñ mi'x juu'ñ bhaan gu ñi'ook jix búup ka't pai'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu vaak jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook mi'x juu'ñ gu novɨ gu u'vɨ gu chuukug bɨɨx o'oo gu kutun gu bhóogɨt bhañ gu ux bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu chuukug chɨtda; gio ba' mɨɨjidha' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' buupui jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' dhi' jix maa gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' moor bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jum daa'ñ gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu duukam gu chio'ñ dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu masad gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt jix duñia' gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Israeel a'ga jix tɨ'ɨ gu Mispa; gio ba' gui'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook ka't dhi' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Lebita gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ muukix; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' gu chuukug gu Benjamiin bɨɨx gu u'vɨ na ba' mambhɨɨx gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo bhaan tu' gu chuukug jix duñia' bhaan tu' gu vaak gu tukaa' bɨɨx gu suudai' kooda' jix duñia' gu u'vɨ jix duñia' ka't muukix.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' dhaagɨk tu' gu u'vɨ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ux bɨx gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Israeel; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨx gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu kutun.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu duukam gu chio'ñ jix búup gui'p; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch gu ñi'ook vaak zel tu' gu takarui' maa'n gu vaak.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm jix duu dhi' bhaan gu chuukug; na mi'x juu'ñ mamai'chɨk bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ chamaam gu ux bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel jix bhai'x chamaam jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu ja'tkam tu' bɨx jiimchu' bhaan gu chuukug gu Benjamiin jurtu'nka' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jugi gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel bhaan kiicham gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu duukam gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel mɨjɨ gu chichio'ñ gu ux bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu chuukug tu' jix duñia' gu kutun tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' jano' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Belial gu chuukug na ba' gu chuukug gu takarui' cham bhai' gu Israeel; gu' gu Benjamiin cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook xibhɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' va'k gu Benjamiin jum daa'ñ jɨ'dɨlh gu chuukug na ba' jix buus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jɨ'dɨlh gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii cham jix koi gu chuukug jix bɨɨx duu gu ux jix duñia' gu chuukug gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't gu chuukug gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx jix duñia' gu jodai bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel mai' gu Benjamiin gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' chɨkka jix tɨ'ɨ no'ch maa'n bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Judaa maa'n.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix dhaas yooxi' bhaan gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' moor gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jugi bhaan gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel gu vaak gu chuukug bhaan ju'ñdharan gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gamai' jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jix duñia' gu oidha' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jix duñia' gu vaak gu chuukug pai' gu suudai' jix duñia' maa'n gu tanoolh.

Na gu' na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook buimgidhak gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gook gu tanoolh gamai' gu Benjamiin gu chuukug bhaan jix duñia' gu ux gu oidha' mambhɨɨx gu tasi' jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx jix duñia' gu kuchii.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx gu ja'tkam tɨɨtɨs gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix dhadhaa vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tɨkka gu Jawatan Dios na gu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix duñia' vupui bhaan mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gui'p; gio ba' gu jodai' jix buus gu chuukug bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin xibhɨk dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu xibh tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Israeel gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xikoolh gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin vaik gu tanoolh gu vaak gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu chuukug na ja'p mui'kim.

Jano' ba' gamai' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin bhaan gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n jix bɨɨx duu kiicham kua'da' gu ñi'ook dhɨt gu ja'tkam gu jodai' na ja'p mui'kim gu ux gu bhóogɨt maa'n jix tɨ'ɨ gu Bet-el gu chuukug yooxi'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Benkidos vupui bhaan no'ch na ja'p va'k; gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel am:―Ja'pji; jano' ba' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n kiicham bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' kɨkbo bɨx gu Israeel pai' jix dhaas gu vaak gu Baal-tamar; gio ba' gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel moor pai' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bhaan gu chuukug mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu Israeel gu chuukug kua'da' gu chuukug; gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham bhai' jix duñia' bhaan.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Benjamiin vupui bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu suudai' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu Benjamiin bɨx jix duñia' gu kuchii.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jix duñia' koko'kam; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu suudai' jix maa pai' gu Benjamiin na gu' mi'p gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu chuukug jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx kiicham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Israelitas mi'p gu suudai' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix jai' gu tai na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ kuubh kiicham.

Jano' ba' gu Israeel suulh gu chuukug gu Benjamiin kua'da' gu o'o gu chuukug gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ tu' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak vupui bhaan no'ch na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk mɨmɨim kua'da' jix tɨ'ɨ kiicham gu vaak kuubh gu Benjamiin jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu tai kiicham jix tɨ'ɨ gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel gu Benjamiin jix duñia' choo'n; na gu' jix duñia' cham bhai' ka't tɨbiap bhaan.
Jano' ba' suulh gu ux gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu Israeel bhaan gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki; gu' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu takarui' kiicham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Benjamiin jix duñia' dɨr gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bhaan pai' gu bhóogɨt gu tas.
Jano' ba' ia'rɨ gu Benjamiin mambhɨɨx gu tasi' jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk jiboi'ññor bhaan oidha' jix gaki gu jodai' na jix uam gu Rimmoon jix duñia' jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu Gidom jix duñia' gook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Benjamiin jix koko' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Gu' gu' suulh jiboi'ññor oidha' jix gaki gu jodai' na jix uam gu Rimmoon gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam gu Rimmoon maakobh masaa'n.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax kiicham bɨx ka't gaagam; gio ba' gu suudai' jix dhaas gu tai bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Mispa bham; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch maa'n mar u'vɨ gu Benjamiin gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix duu gu ñi'ook gui'p.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu ja'tkam jix búup gu xibh gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gui'p gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na gu' chɨkka bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu masad mia'n gu Jawatan Dios na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan cham jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook koi'm.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' kuiñcha gu Benjamiin xibhɨk gui'p; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda' gu jodai' gu u'vɨ na ba' jix duñia' no'ch gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios cham gu jodai' gu chuukug mar u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch oi'ñdha' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel cham ka't jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu Mispa gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jabes-galaad ka't tɨbiap yooxi' gu masad.
Na gu' na gu' gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' cham ka't gu chio'ñ jix koi gu Jabes-galaad.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhañ gu kutun jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix koi gu Jabes-galaad gu u'vɨ a'aalh.
Gu' gu' jix duu dhi'; gio ba' yaa' bɨx gu chio'ñ bɨx gu u'vɨ ka't gu tasi' gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi gu Jabes-galaad gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' cham jix daa gu tasi' gu chio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ aichdhak yooxi' gu Silo gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhañ ñiokda' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin mi'p gu jodai' na jix uam gu Rimmoon tɨɨt bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' suulh jano' ba' gu Benjamiin; gio ba' jix maa gu ux gu u'vɨ gu suudai' nukadham na jix do'ig gu u'vɨ gu Jabes-galaad; gu' cham jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu vaak kuiñcha gu Benjamiin gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' daraa gu ñi'ook gui'p; na gu' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ na ba' jix duñia' na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu u'vɨ ka't jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gui'p; na gu' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' ka't gu Benjamiin na gu' cham ka't bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Na gu' no'ch cham gu ñi'ook cham gu takarui' gu chuukug gu u'vɨ mar u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu kutun jix maa gu u'vɨ gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' jano' xoi'kam gui'p gu suudai' oidha' tas cham tu'x jai'ch jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Silo gu ñi'ook gu Bet-el gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' gu bhóogɨt jix tɨ'ɨ gu Bet-el gu Sikêm saagi'ñ gu Lebona.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin bham; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu maa'nkar oidha' u'va.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug; na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' jix buus ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Silo gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va jix duñia' maa'n gu u'vɨ na ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Silo gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Benjamiin.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt tattat gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt no'ch gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' no'ch pai'; na gu' no'ch bhɨɨ'ñdham cham jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ na ba' bɨx; na gu takarui' cham jix duñia' jix maa na ba' jano' ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jix duu; na gu' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh jix daa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gio maa'n bopxi'ñ ja'tkam vaak gamai' maa'n gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' maa'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui.
